sourceText: Open an implementation Story and develop the complete B-f646 execution plan. The program has seven milestones M6A through M6G, development must use the milestone ledger, and completion must report total token consumption and the largest cost source.
normalizedOutcome: The bounded multi-host candidate-spec router is implemented end to end across M6A-M6G, all ledger milestones have current passing evidence, the Story reaches DONE, and the final report includes measured token usage with uncertainty labels.
acceptanceClaim: B-8038 is DONE with all seven confirmed ledger milestones covered by passing verification evidence, no requirements corpus prompt injection, quality thresholds satisfied, and a token-cost breakdown reported.
